quirks.description: Contentful image URLs: images.ctfassets.net/<spaceId>/<assetId>/<hash>/filename.ext. Space IDs are 12 chars lowercase. Asset IDs are 1-64 chars. Hash is 32-char hex (MD5).
quirks.workaround: Extract asset ID from second path segment after space ID.

quirks.description: Images API supports on-the-fly format conversion: ?fm=webp, ?fm=avif. AVIF has 9 Megapixel source image limit. SVGs can be rasterized with ?fm=webp.
quirks.workaround: Use ?fm=webp for optimized delivery. Fall back to WebP for images >9MP that can't use AVIF. Skip SVG format conversion to preserve vector quality.

quirks.description: ?fit= controls crop: pad (letterbox), fill (crop to exact), scale (stretch), crop (crop), thumb (thumbnail crop). Default is fit=pad which may add letterboxing.
quirks.workaround: Use ?fit=fill for cropped images. Match fit mode to CSS object-fit on the img element.

quirks.description: EU customers use images.eu.ctfassets.net instead of images.ctfassets.net. Same API params, different domain.
Old images.contentful.com domain 301 redirects to images.ctfassets.net. Sites using old domain incur redirect penalty.
quirks.workaround: Normalize URLs to ctfassets.net during extraction.

quirks.description: assets.ctfassets.net serves raw files without Image API support. images.ctfassets.net supports all transformation params.
quirks.workaround: Use images subdomain for raster optimization. Download from assets subdomain as raw files.

quirks.description: Width and height params capped at 4000px. Requesting ?w=5000 returns HTTP 400.
